full_text: Python is a high-level programming language known for its readability and versatility. It supports multiple programming paradigms including procedural, object-oriented, and functional programming.
To install Python on your system, download the installer from python.org. On Linux you can use apt-get install python3. Always verify the installation with python --version.
List comprehensions in Python provide a concise way to create lists. Syntax: [expr for item in iterable if condition]. They are faster than equivalent for-loops for building lists.
Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence that enables systems to learn from data. Common types include supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and reinforcement learning.
Neural networks consist of layers of interconnected nodes. Each node applies a weighted sum and activation function. Deep learning uses networks with many hidden layers.
SQL stands for Structured Query Language. Use SELECT to query data, INSERT to add rows, UPDATE to modify, and DELETE to remove. Always use WHERE to filter when updating or deleting.
Database indexes speed up queries by creating a data structure that allows fast lookup. Create indexes on columns used in WHERE and JOIN. Too many indexes can slow down writes.
REST APIs use HTTP methods: GET for reading, POST for creating, PUT for full updates, PATCH for partial updates, DELETE for removing resources. Use proper status codes like 200 and 404.
API authentication can use API keys, OAuth 2.0, or JWT tokens. Never send secrets in URL query params. Prefer Bearer tokens in the Authorization header.
Docker containers package an application and its dependencies. Use docker build to create images and docker run to start containers. Dockerfile defines the image build steps.
Git workflow: create branch, make commits, push to remote. Use git pull before pushing. Merge or rebase to integrate changes. Resolve conflicts carefully.
Pandas provides DataFrame for tabular data. Read CSV with pd.read_csv. Filter with boolean indexing. Group by with groupby(). Merge tables with merge() or join().
NumPy arrays are fast fixed-type arrays. Create with np.array() or np.zeros(). Vectorized operations avoid Python loops. Use reshape and broadcasting for multi-dimensional data.
Linear regression models the relationship between variables with a linear equation. Minimize mean squared error. Use gradient descent or closed-form solution. Check residuals for assumptions.

Classification predicts discrete labels. Logistic regression, decision trees, and SVMs are common. Evaluate with accuracy, precision, recall, and F1. Handle imbalanced classes with sampling or weights.
Embeddings map text or items to dense vectors. Similar items have similar vectors. Used for search, recommendations, and RAG. Train with contrastive loss or use pre-trained models.
FAISS is a library for efficient similarity search. Build an index from vectors, then search for k nearest neighbors. Supports GPU and various index types like IVF and HNSW.
Retrieval-augmented generation combines retrieval and generation. Retrieve relevant documents, then pass them as context to an LLM. Improves factual accuracy and reduces hallucination.
PostgreSQL is an open-source relational database. Install with package manager, then initdb and start the server. Create database with CREATE DATABASE. Use psql for the command-line client.
Redis is an in-memory key-value store. Use for caching, sessions, and queues. Commands: SET, GET, INCR. Set TTL with EXPIRE. Use connection pooling in production.
HTTP has request and response. Request has method, path, headers, body. Response has status code, headers, body. Common codes: 200 OK, 201 Created, 400 Bad Request, 500 Server Error.
JSON is a text format for data exchange. Objects use curly braces, arrays use square brackets. Parse with json.loads() in Python. Validate schema for APIs.
Async in Python uses async/await. Define async def for coroutines. Run with asyncio.run(). Use await for I/O-bound tasks. Avoid blocking calls inside async functions.
pytest discovers tests in test_*.py files. Use assert for checks. Fixtures provide setup. Run with pytest -v. Mock with pytest-mock or unittest.mock.
Use the logging module. Set level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR. Configure handlers for file and console. Use structured logging for production. Do not log secrets.
Store config in environment variables. In Python use os.environ or python-dotenv. Never commit .env to git. Use different values per environment.
CI/CD automates build, test, and deploy. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins are options. Run tests on every push. Deploy to staging then production with approval.
Kubernetes orchestrates containers. Pods are the smallest unit. Deployments manage replicas. Services expose pods. Use kubectl to manage the cluster.
Transformers use self-attention over sequences. No recurrence, parallelizable. BERT for encoding, GPT for generation. Pre-train then fine-tune on downstream tasks.
Fine-tuning adapts a pre-trained model to your task. Use smaller learning rate. Freeze early layers optionally. Need labeled data. Watch for overfitting on small datasets.
Sentence transformers produce semantic embeddings. Models like all-MiniLM-L6-v2 are fast. Use for semantic search and retrieval. Encode with model.encode(texts).
For RAG, chunk documents into overlapping segments. Typical size 256-512 tokens. Overlap preserves context. Chunk by paragraph or sentence for cleaner boundaries.
Evaluation: accuracy for classification, BLEU/ROUGE for generation, recall@k for retrieval. Use held-out test set. Track metrics over time in production.
Security: validate input, use parameterized queries for SQL, escape output for XSS. HTTPS only. Keep dependencies updated. Principle of least privilege.
Rate limiting protects APIs from abuse. Limit by IP or API key. Use token bucket or sliding window. Return 429 Too Many Requests. Set Retry-After header.
Monitoring: collect metrics (Prometheus), logs (ELK), traces (Jaeger). Set alerts on error rate and latency. Use dashboards for visibility. Define SLOs.
Caching: cache-aside, write-through, write-behind. Set TTL. Invalidate on updates. Use ETag for conditional requests. Cache at CDN for static assets.
Microservices split an app into small services. Each has its own deployment and data. Communicate via HTTP or message queue. Handle partial failure and eventual consistency.
Handle errors explicitly. Use try/except in Python. Log and re-raise or return error response. Custom exception types for domain errors. Fail fast in development.
Type hints improve readability and enable static checking. Use typing module: List, Dict, Optional. Run mypy for type checking. Gradual typing is supported.
Virtual environments isolate project dependencies. Create with python -m venv venv. Activate with source venv/bin/activate. Use pip or poetry for packages.
Pin versions in requirements.txt or pyproject.toml. Use lock files for reproducible installs. Separate dev and prod dependencies. Audit with pip-audit.
Preprocessing: handle missing values, normalize or standardize, encode categories. Split into train/val/test. Avoid data leakage from test set.
Cross-validation splits data into folds. Train on k-1, validate on 1, rotate. Use for small datasets. Stratified k-fold for classification to preserve class balance.
Tune hyperparameters with grid search, random search, or Bayesian optimization. Use validation set. Consider Optuna or Ray Tune for efficiency.
Serve models via REST API or gRPC. Use batch inference for throughput. Version models and A/B test. Monitor latency and throughput in production.
ETL: Extract from sources, Transform (clean, aggregate), Load into warehouse. Use Airflow or Prefect for scheduling. Idempotent and resumable pipelines.
Data warehouse stores historical data for analytics. Star or snowflake schema. Dimension and fact tables. Use for reporting and BI tools.
Version control tracks changes. Commit often with clear messages. Use branches for features. Tag releases. .gitignore sensitive and generated files.
Document code with docstrings and comments. Keep README updated. Use Sphinx or MkDocs for API docs. Document decisions in ADRs. Examples help users.
